scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-pulse/server && npm run build -w @ai-pulse/widget
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run start -w @ai-pulse/widget
scripts.gate: npm run build && node --check packages/web/app.js && node --check packages/web/x-embed.js && node --check packages/widget/renderer/settings.js && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: node --import tsx packages/server/scripts/smoke-regressions.ts && node --import tsx packages/server/scripts/news-smoke-regressions.ts && node --import tsx packages/server/scripts/storage-smoke-regressions.ts && node --import tsx packages/server/scripts/social-smoke-regressions.ts && node --import tsx packages/server/scripts/public-sources-smoke.ts && node --import tsx packages/server/scripts/youtube-channels-smoke.ts && node packages/server/scripts/x-embed-smoke.mjs
